summary: Validated the CRITICAL density-suggestion Apply fix (bounding-box union + largest-as-survivor) on slides #13 and #9 of project 83dffbd3-5aee-4140-b81c-f0395c061a6b. Primary user-facing goal CONFIRMED PASSING on both slides: after clicking 'Aplicar', neither slide is blank, and the new prose is rendered at a readable size in a large body iframe — NOT squashed into a 50px header strip (which was the original P0 bug). Smoke checks on slides #1 (Capa) and #2 still render. One nuance found on slide #13: the small orange header banner (1920x50) was NOT dropped — both the header strip and the body iframe (1760x700, with new applied content) survived, so the slide ends up with 2 textual elements instead of the spec's expected 1 merged element. On slide #9 the merge worked exactly as designed (single 1920x780 iframe). The user-visible UX is good on both slides; the header-not-dropped on slide #13 is a logic gap, not a visual regression.

ui_bugs.issue: After Apply on slide #13, the slide STILL has 2 html iframes (header strip 1920x50 + body 1760x700) instead of the expected 1 merged element. The body iframe correctly carries the new prose at a readable size, so the slide is NOT visually broken; however the survivor-merge step did not drop the smaller textual element on this slide. Worked correctly on slide #9 (collapsed to a single 1920x780 iframe). Possible cause: the header element on slide #13 may not match the TEXTUAL_TYPES whitelist exactly (e.g. type==='shape' rather than 'html'), OR there are >2 textual elements with overlapping types and the filter only finds one pair. Recommend inspecting slide #13 element types in MongoDB to confirm.

rca of the issue: Primary RCA: original bug was that onApply picked elements[0] (the small 1920x50 header banner) as survivor and squashed the new prose into a 50px strip. NEW fix (SlideProperties.jsx lines 364-396) picks the LARGEST textual element by area=width*height and expands its box to the UNION of all textual element bounding boxes, then drops the others. Verified on slide #9: 2 iframes → 1 iframe at 1920x780 (union: min(0,80)→0, min(0,80)→0, max(1920,1760+80)→1920, max(50,80+700)→780). Slide #13 result is anomalous (header NOT dropped); likely a slide-composition quirk rather than a logic bug, but worth verifying with a MongoDB query of slide elements.
